# egui-scale local patch

Vendored crates.io egui-scale 0.6.1 (license `MIT OR Apache-2.0`, as its
`Cargo.toml` states; the crate ships no license file). It is a dependency
of the vendored `egui-snarl`. Upstream depends on egui 0.36; Terminator
uses egui 0.37.

Change: `Cargo.toml`: egui 0.36 becomes 0.37.
